body:
CHANGELOG updated in GoblinFoxDragon: Fixed a real, found-live gap: Home Point never persisted across a real SSH reconnect (founder: 'home point does not persist after logouts'). applyFetchedCharacter -- the function every real SSH reconnect goes through -- never restored p.homePoint from the character record, even though sethome correctly persisted it to IDUNA already. getOrCreateHeadlessPlayer's own connect path had this fix since 2026-08-04 but it was never applied to the real player-facing path. Extracted into a shared restoreHomePointFromCharacter used by both paths now. 2 new tests. Found but not fixed in the same pass: the telnet mudCharCache returning-guest branch has the identical gap, entangled with an unrelated in-flight change, flagged for next pickup. Commit bd5a7a6 (source, not yet deployed -- holding the restart so it doesn't drop two live demo SSH sessions currently running for the founder). (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)

⚓ ☃
